card.name: Second piece of split abbreviations
card.fires_on: A short letter piece that completes or continues an abbreviation or acronym, such as the e in ARPA-E, the d in Pd, the cr in Clcr, or the m in mEq. Seen mostly in dosing and lab-measure text.

modes.label: Clinical abbreviations
modes.description: Later letters of dosing or lab abbreviations like Clcr, mEq, BSA, dw, NRTI.

modes.description: A single letter after a word, serving as a label or part of an acronym.

card.writes: It seems to push toward capital-letter pieces and away from ordinary words, which fits the middle of an acronym.
card.plain: It fires on the trailing letters of an abbreviation that the model has split into pieces.
